paras: Hoge's worm lizard (Amphisbaena hogei) is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is endemic to Brazil.
The specific name, hogei, is in honor of Belgian-Brazilian herpetologist Alphonse Richard Hoge.
A. hogei is found in the Brazilian states of Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.
The preferred natural habitat of A. hogei is forest.
A small species, A. hogei may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 13.4 cm (5.3 in). It has 177–191 body annuli and 15–19 tail annuli. It is brown dorsally, and it is paler ventrally.
A. hogei is terrestrial and fossorial.
